newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PLDT, San Mig boost Manila shares at close.
newsitem.headline: PLDT, San Mig boost Manila shares at close.

text.p: Manila shares extended their rally on Wednesday with the market closing higher on rises in both PLDT and San Miguel Corp.
"The market has recovered from Monday's decline because of bargain-hunting," said Jonas Ferrer, research head at Dharmala Securities (Philippines) Inc.
The main index finished up 22.89 points, or 0.79 percent, to 2,927.30 points.
The market opened strong as a result of PLDT's reported 32 percent increase in nine-month profits but it was pulled back by foreign selling, traders said.

PLDT closed up 40 pesos to 1,585 pesos along with San Miguel Corp which finished up by 50 centavos to 46.50. Index heavyweight Petron Corp was marred by heavy foreign selling and closed at its year-low of 7.50 pesos, down by 60 centavos.

"There may be some profit-taking tomorrow because of the two-day runup and the long weekend ahead," said Bogart Cruz, trading manager at Asia Pacific Capital Equities & Securities Corp. -KATHERINE ESPINA 63 2 841-8937 Fax 8176267
